structured_output.summary: A small _mode_600() helper in cli.py returns " (mode 600)" except on win32. All five messages use it, so text elsewhere is byte-for-byte unchanged, and the chmod call is kept. The _store_key docstring now reads "(chmod 600)", true on both platforms in the same number of words. The new test monkeypatches sys.platform to win32, mirrors the existing assertion (which still passes untouched) and fails when the helper is reverted. XDG_CONFIG_HOME still takes precedence over APPDATA under win32, so the test stays isolated. Ruff passes, and test_llm.py plus test_cli.py pass (157). The full suite's one failure (test_backlog: ROADMAP.md:67 dangling BL-039) comes from the commit-time bookkeeping, which removed the BACKLOG entry but not the ROADMAP reference. That is outside the graded change but should be fixed before merging.
